summary: Conditional boolean flag query. Evaluates a packed byte field on the object through ByteFieldExtractorWithShift; when it reports true, reads a dword through a pointer reached from the ecx register context (v1) offset by 32 bytes, and returns true only when that value is in the range 1..2. Returns false otherwise. Used as a state/flag guard by menu, HUD and session callers on the frame path.

local_names.this: object whose packed byte field drives the condition
local_names.v1: ecx register context used as a pointer base for the offset-32 dword read
local_names.v2: dword value read at pointer plus 32 bytes, range-tested against 1..2

operations.description: Evaluates a packed byte field on the object through ByteFieldExtractorWithShift(this)
Proceeds only when the byte field extractor returns non-zero
Reads a dword through the pointer reached from the ecx register context (v1), offset by 32 bytes, into v2
Returns true only when the read value v2 is greater than 0 and at most 2
Returns 1 on the in-range condition, otherwise returns 0
Used as a state/flag guard by callers such as MainMenuTransition and HUDFlagRendererMain
